content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Sponsors ## slug: evbuilder-object-sponsor ## seoTitle: Sponsors ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The following updates were made to the {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} object. ## Field Mapping The field mapping between the {{variable.Object_Sponsor}} and {{variable.Object_Account}}objects is as follows. | **Source Field** | **Target Field** | | --- | --- | | Account Bio | Sponsor Description | | Account Name | Sponsor Display Name | |Account Website | Sponsor Website | | Account Image URL | Sponsor Image URL | ## Tiers * {{variable.Object_Sponsor}}s can be grouped by standard Tiers or by custom Tiers. The standard options include "Platinum", "Gold", "Silver", and "Bronze". They appear at the top of the {{variable.Object_Sponsor}}s section. * Custom Tiers are located below the standard options and are ordered by Name A to Z. * {{variable.Object_Sponsor}}s who are not assigned a {{variable.Field_Sponsor_Tier}} will be located below the Custom Tiers section in the Additional Sponsors section.
